observation: Interface heterogeneity is selected for OS/PFI/DFI; OS boosting nominates plasma–stroma variability and T–myeloid range. DSS nominates T nuclear assortativity, PFI T roundness. Refine scale contrasts and robust patient spread instead of repeating nuclear/cytoplasm ratios.

definitions.R5R2__interface_contrast_25: T–epithelial minus T–stromal boundary-crossing fraction at 25µm
definitions.R5R2__interface_contrast_100: T–epithelial minus T–stromal boundary-crossing fraction at 100µm
definitions.R5R2__interface_graph_coupling: Boundary-crossing contrast × epithelial/stromal T-neighbor enrichment contrast
definitions.R5R2__plasma_stroma_radial_separation: Plasma core/rim gradient minus stromal gradient
definitions.R5R2__plasma_stroma_scale_contrast: Plasma–stromal graph coupling at short versus longer scale
